text:
elaine_cs: Quick rollup from onboarding sessions with 5 customers this week. Key product asks: (1) per-route cost breakdown (hourly option), (2) an admin onboarding checklist with compliance prompts, (3) a set of vetted prompt templates for PHI/PII redaction, and (4) configurable renewal-risk alerts. Adding here so we can prioritize against upcoming renewals.

hiro_pm: Good list. Which customers flagged renewals? Any that would pay for prioritized delivery?

elain e_cs: Typos fixed: Parklane and HelixCardio mentioned renewals in next 60 days. Parklane said they'd consider paying for early delivery if we can show per-route billing.

marta_eng: On per-route billing: simplest early approach is a CSV export by route+day. Backend: small ETL job + index changes. Frontend: a table view + download button. Est 3 engineer-days to deliver MVP.

jon_csm: Raw call snippets: "We need to see cost per endpoint" — Parklane; "Templates for clinical prompts would save us time" — HelixCardio. I'll set up follow-ups.

notif-bot: Reminder: Add to productboard and tag 'renewal-risk' and 'onboarding' https://productboard.example/redwood

hiro_pm: Proposed next steps: 1) CS validates scope + gauge paid fast-path interest (elaine/jon) 2) Eng spike CSV export (marta) 3) PM creates productboard ticket & links to calls (hiro) 4) Ship alpha within 6 weeks for high-risk accounts. Agree?

elain e_cs: Agree. I'll confirm with Parklane this afternoon and update thread.

marta_eng: Also note: for PHI/PII prompt templates we'll need legal sign-off and an initial scrubber in the UI. We can include a "redaction suggestions" toggle in the templates modal as v1.

hiro_pm: Great. Everyone add any follow-up snippets to this thread.

jon_csm: I'll capture customer willingness to pay during the follow-up call.
